rule: Do not spawn sub-agents unless the user or applicable AGENTS.md/skill instructions explicitly ask for sub-agents, delegation, or parallel agent work.
taskRemove: Read-only research MUST use `scout` only when files unknown.
MUST be used for exploratory codebase research, rapid code analysis, and broad pattern searches.
evalRemove:
Subagents have separate kernels.
For 2+ independent items, use a named `workpool()`; results auto-deliver. If blocked, leave `eval` and call `wait`.
- `agent`, `workpool`: background subagents, DAG waves → `xd://eval/agents`
evalDefault: Use JavaScript (Bun) by default. Use Python only for rare tasks requiring Python-specific libraries, such as pandas, NumPy or Matplotlib.
evalFiles: For project file reading and searching, use the read, grep and glob tools. Use eval for computation, not as a substitute for those tools.
specificNew: Omit `agent` by default: a general worker equal to you. `scout` only for read-only search over unknown files; `sonic` only for mechanical edits with exact instructions. The user names an agent type: pass it in `agent`. The user names a model or effort: set `model` to `provider/id:level` (your own model if none named), no `agent`. Levels: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` (extra high), `max`; pass exactly the level the user says.
blocked: Direct agent() and workpool() calls are blocked in eval. Use the task tool for explicitly requested delegation.
